page.layout: One printed title page, one block of text: the title lines at the top, an engraving of an armillary sphere in the centre, the imprint below it. Handwritten annotations in the right margin are not printed and are left out.
page.notes: The engraving shows an armillary sphere with a meridian ring and a shadow-band; it is not text. The handwritten marks at the right edge are manuscript annotations, not print. The watermark-like "http://rcin.org.pl" at the foot is a digitiser's link and is omitted. The title lines are rendered with the printed hyphens at line ends ("RE-", "COR-") as shown; the title in capitals is set in large roman type.
